description: This file defines an interface 'DataGenerator' within the 'FastRoute' namespace. It specifies methods for adding routes and retrieving dispatcher data, serving as a contract for route data generation implementations in a routing library.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Method to add a route to the data generator, specifying HTTP method, route data, and handler.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Method to retrieve the route data in an implementation-specific format.
